data.falsifier: The outcome would list a second finding kind (crashed/stalled) or a non-empty moves, or the sleeper process would be terminated.
data.mechanism: progress_of drops a job whose age reaches runaway_s from the 'busy' set so it classifies as RUNAWAY; the lane stays live because the lease TTL (1800s) still holds at +120s, so core.health._judge emits no CRASHED/STALLED row; healthwatch.correct has no RUNAWAY branch, so moves==[] and the watchdog never signals a process.
